commands.cmd:
set -u
PIN=$(python3 -c '
import json, glob
stack = [c["version"] for c in json.load(open("manifests/stack.json"))["components"] if c["id"] == "promptfoo"]
pins = sorted({w["pin"] for f in glob.glob("catalogs/landscape/*.json") for l in json.load(open(f)).get("layers", []) for w in (l.get("winners") or []) if w.get("component_id") == "promptfoo"})
assert stack == ["0.123.1"] and pins == ["0.123.1"], (stack, pins)
print("manifests/stack.json", stack, "| catalogs/landscape winner pins", pins)
') || { echo "FAIL: manifests/stack.json and the catalogs/landscape winner pins are not all promptfoo 0.123.1"; exit 1; }
NV=$(DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm_config_audit=false npm_config_fund=false timeout 30 npm view promptfoo@0.123.1 dist.integrity dist.shasum --json) || { echo "FAIL: npm view promptfoo@0.123.1 exited $?"; exit 1; }
REG=$(python3 -c '
import json, sys
r = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
assert r == {"dist.integrity": "sha512-9WzFeH6L+5E49R6CTulBo/WzmVPNcMpvgUZAyEsNlaKgpfmF9vV82jKUG1rQ+QH79P7gYAaxeY3TvLDV+x0Cbg==", "dist.shasum": "96a901bcc5c43d0b52b42144a49b3d77b1699e25"}, r
print("dist.integrity", r["dist.integrity"], "| dist.shasum", r["dist.shasum"])
' "$NV") || { echo "FAIL: the npm registry digests for promptfoo@0.123.1 are not the expected values: $NV"; exit 1; }
echo "PASS promptfoo 0.123.1: pin cross-check and npm registry digests"
echo "npm view promptfoo@0.123.1 $REG"
echo "$PIN"

DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm_config_audit=false npm_config_fund=false timeout 60 npm ls --global --prefix "$P" --all --json >"$T/ls.json" 2>"$T/ls.err"
rc=$?
python3 -c '
import json, sys
prefix, rc = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])
tree = json.load(open(sys.argv[3]))
assert tree["dependencies"]["promptfoo"]["version"] == "0.123.1", tree["dependencies"]["promptfoo"]
known = "invalid: chokidar@5.0.0 " + prefix + "/lib/node_modules/promptfoo/node_modules/chokidar"
problems = tree.get("problems", [])
assert set(problems) <= {known}, problems
assert rc == (1 if problems else 0), rc
print("PASS npm ls --all exit", rc, "|", len(problems), "problem(s), none unexpected")
for problem in problems:
    print(problem.replace(prefix, "<prefix>"))
if problems:
    pkg = lambda sub: json.load(open(prefix + "/lib/node_modules/promptfoo/" + sub + "package.json"))
    root, nun = pkg(""), pkg("node_modules/nunjucks/")
    print("nunjucks@" + nun["version"], "peerDependencies.chokidar", nun["peerDependencies"]["chokidar"], "(optional:", str(nun["peerDependenciesMeta"]["chokidar"]["optional"]) + ");", "promptfoo@" + root["version"], "dependencies.chokidar", root["dependencies"]["chokidar"] + ", overrides.chokidar", root["overrides"]["chokidar"])
print("prefix:", prefix)
' "$P" "$rc" "$T/ls.json" || { echo "FAIL: npm ls --all over $P (exit $rc) is not in the expected state"; head -c 400 "$T/ls.err"; exit 1; }
